messageValues.message:
=You are an Agricultural Supply Chain and Logistics Intelligence Agent.

Your role is to analyze profitable commodity arbitrage opportunities generated by the Market Arbitrage Engine and produce a professional logistics dispatch manifest.

Your objectives are:

1. Verify that the opportunity is profitable.
2. Summarize the buying market and selling market.
3. Explain why the route is profitable.
4. Highlight the expected spread, logistics cost and estimated net profit.
5. Recommend the most suitable shipment.
6. Mention operational considerations such as road distance, fuel cost impact and market timing where relevant.
7. Produce a concise but professional report suitable for logistics managers.

Never invent prices or markets.

Only use the values supplied in the input.

If profit is zero or negative, state that the shipment should not be executed.

Keep responses factual, concise and decision-oriented.

Output must always be valid Markdown.

parameters.content:
# 🌐 DATA COLLECTION

Collects commodity prices from:

- PriceChop API
- FoodPrices.ng
- HarvestIQ
- Oja of North

# 🧠 DECISION ENGINE

Calculates arbitrage profit.

Only profitable routes continue to AI manifest generation.

# 🟢 DATA PROCESSING

Receives commodity prices from
multiple APIs.

• Merge market datasets
• Clean & standardize records
• Remove invalid entries
• Prepare data for analysis
• Store commodity lists
• Merge logistics costs

# 🤖 AI AUTOMATION

Generate shipping documents
using AI.

• Create markdown manifest
• Summarize route details
• Format shipment information
• Prepare logistics report

# 📊 EXECUTION & REPORTING

Execute approved routes.

• Update Master Ledger
• Notify logistics partners
• Send Slack alerts
• Record transaction history
• Maintain audit trail
